description: Four voices running through a chaotic flow field by Simone Conradi, each read at a chosen iteration and put out as an X and a Y, at rates from very slow modulation up to audio

params.text: Sets the rate of all four voices, -4 to 4 octaves from the frequency the Speed button chooses
Scales the FM input, -1 to 1; with no cable in the FM jack no modulation is added at all
Crossfades both outputs from a lowpass at fully counter-clockwise to a highpass at fully clockwise, an equal mix of the two at the centre; no distortion is applied, despite the panel printing Drive
Places voice one in the field before the iteration starts, -1.5 to 1.5; with a cable in the Position 1 jack this knob multiplies that voltage instead
Places voice two in the field before the iteration starts, -1.5 to 1.5; with a cable in Position 1 or Position 2 this knob multiplies that voltage instead
Places voice three in the field before the iteration starts, -1.5 to 1.5; with a cable in any Position jack numbered 3 or less this knob multiplies that voltage instead
Places voice four in the field before the iteration starts, -1.5 to 1.5; with a cable in any Position jack this knob multiplies that voltage instead
Squashes the flow field, -2 to 2, and sets the corner of the output filter as well, 220Hz at one unit and doubling for each unit above that
Sets the radius of the circle that drives the whole system, 0 to 1.5
Scales the Gain input, -1 to 1; with no cable in the Gain jack that jack counts as 1, so this knob adds its own setting straight to the Gain knob
Sets the first constant of the flow field, -3.14 to 3.14
Sets the second constant of the flow field, -3.14 to 3.14; 1.9 is taken off it inside the equation, so centring both constants centres the output
Chooses which of the eight iterations of the field voice one is read from, 1 at fully counter-clockwise to 6 at fully clockwise, a setting between two iterations crossfading them
Chooses which of the eight iterations of the field voice two is read from, 1 at fully counter-clockwise to 6 at fully clockwise, a setting between two iterations crossfading them
Chooses which of the eight iterations of the field voice three is read from, 1 at fully counter-clockwise to 6 at fully clockwise, a setting between two iterations crossfading them
Chooses which of the eight iterations of the field voice four is read from, 1 at fully counter-clockwise to 6 at fully clockwise, a setting between two iterations crossfading them
Steps through the three frequencies the Pitch knob's centre gives: Torpid at 0.0319Hz, Waves at 4.0875Hz and Voice at 130.8Hz, which is the one the module starts on
Shifts voice two away from the rate the other voices run at, -12 to 12 semitones
Shifts voice three away from the rate the other voices run at, -12 to 12 semitones
Shifts voice four away from the rate the other voices run at, -12 to 12 semitones

inputs.text: Added to the Pitch knob for voice one at one volt per octave, and sets voices two, three and four as well while their own jacks are empty
Added to the Pitch knob for voice two at one volt per octave, and sets voices three and four as well while their own jacks are empty; with no cable voice two takes voice one's rate
Added to the Pitch knob for voice three at one volt per octave, and sets voice four as well while its jack is empty; with no cable voice three takes voice two's rate
Added to the Pitch knob for voice four at one volt per octave; with no cable voice four takes voice three's rate
Frequency modulation added straight to the coordinates: the voltage is divided by 10 and scaled by the FM knob, the X axis taking it at once and the Y axis 63 samples later
Divided by 5 and multiplied by the Drive knob, so 5V gives the knob's full setting and a negative voltage turns the crossfade the other way
Scaled to -1.5 to 1.5 and multiplied by the Position 1 knob, and it feeds the other three Position knobs as well while their own jacks are empty
Scaled to -1.5 to 1.5 and multiplied by the Position 2 knob, and it feeds the Position 3 and Position 4 knobs as well while their own jacks are empty
Scaled to -1.5 to 1.5 and multiplied by the Position 3 knob, and it feeds the Position 4 knob as well while that jack is empty
Scaled to -1.5 to 1.5 and multiplied by the Position 4 knob
Scaled to -2 to 2 and multiplied by the Wave knob, which makes that knob an attenuverter over this jack
The absolute value of the voltage is scaled to 0 to 1.5, multiplied by the attenuverter and added to the Gain knob, the total clamped to 0 to 1.5
Scaled to -3.14 to 3.14 and added to the Alpha knob, the total clamped to -6.28 and 6.28
Scaled to -3.14 to 3.14 and added to the Beta knob, the total clamped to -6.28 and 6.28
The absolute value of the voltage times 0.6 multiplies the Pull 1 knob, and it feeds the other three Pull knobs as well while their own jacks are empty
The absolute value of the voltage times 0.6 multiplies the Pull 2 knob, and it feeds the Pull 3 and Pull 4 knobs as well while their own jacks are empty
The absolute value of the voltage times 0.6 multiplies the Pull 3 knob, and it feeds the Pull 4 knob as well while that jack is empty
The absolute value of the voltage times 0.6 multiplies the Pull 4 knob

outputs.text: The X coordinate of voice one, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The Y coordinate of voice one, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The X coordinate of voice two, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The Y coordinate of voice two, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The X coordinate of voice three, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The Y coordinate of voice three, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The X coordinate of voice four, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The Y coordinate of voice four, multiplied by 12 and put through the filter the Wave and Drive knobs set
The four X outputs added together and divided by four
The four Y outputs added together and divided by four

notes: the screen draws the flow field as short streaks and marks each of the four voices with a coloured square trail; the colours shift as Alpha, Beta and Drive are turned
on the Voice setting of the Speed button, and only there, both axes are high-passed at 15.2Hz to take the DC offset out
every output is monophonic, whatever is patched in
